author: captain
question_zh: 在冻结的 MLPLOB v3 CSZ 441 日配方与 1.32 预算点上，把单一 30 分钟前向 VWAP 收益标签换成 5/15/30/60 四个期限、一个主干四个输出头、推理时固定等权混合，能否在十窗样本外 RankIC 上相对同预算单头对照取得可复验的改进，且跨期限一致性带来更稳的跨窗表现。
hypothesis_zh: 不同期限的前向 VWAP 收益共享大部分横截面信号但噪声不共线；同一主干上的四个头分别学习各期限，等权混合可以互相抵消期限特异的标签噪声，从而在同一训练预算下提高 RankIC 与跨窗稳定性。若池化配对差低于预先声明的门槛，则本臂的假设被否证。

definition.primary_column: k=30 keeps the official vwap_return target verbatim
definition.rebuild: 5/15/60 rebuilt from the 1-minute bars in one bounded pass
definition.masks: per-horizon NaN masks, never a row drop
definition.trading_clock: lunch break skipped; 11:30 + 30m = 13:30; insufficient session -> NaN
definition.transform: per-horizon timestamp z-score + train-set RMS matching
definition.loss: equal average of per-horizon masked MSE
definition.score: fixed equal average of head outputs in optimization units

default_path_unchanged.claim: absent or [30] is bit-identical to the registered path

label_audit.note: the 60-minute lane is NaN on the 14:30 clock (12.68% of rows), which is the intended edge case, not a row drop; the 30-minute column of the attached matrix is the official target verbatim

code.src/jinyiquant/runner.py: _fit_targets passes the 1-D label or the horizon matrix
code.modified_tlob/model.py: MLPLOB horizons=1 keeps the single head; >1 adds K heads
code.modified_tlob/adapter.py: per-horizon targets/centering, masked MSE, blended score, payload

control.role: the registered 441-day rung at its 1.32 point, three seeds

candidate.role: draft arm D1, multi-horizon labels, three seeds

rung.note_zh: 训练窗、验证窗、评估口径与种子都与 441 日对照完全一致，只有标签期限不同

budget_points.name: mh-1.32
budget_points.role: inherited from the 441-day rung 1.32 point (3522173 usable samples, batch 32, +/-5%)

windows.note_zh: 十窗全部落在每个 checkpoint 的训练窗之外，且不触碰封存区间 [2024-10-08, 2025-01-01]

evaluation.caliber: eval-v2 contract in src/jinyiquant/evaluation.py, gross track, eight clocks per day, no neutralization
evaluation.pairing: candidate - control inside each (seed, window, trading day); then one pooled mean over the three seeds and all 203 (window, day) pairs

uncertainty.method: whole-series circular moving-block bootstrap of the pooled daily mean
uncertainty.block_rule: ceil(n / 5) with n = 203 pooled trading days
uncertainty.retired_estimator: archived_single_block_interval is the pre-fix estimator whose half width was sqrt(n / 5) too wide; it may reproduce archived readings but may never gate this decision

thresholds.positive_rule: a window counts as positive when its own pooled paired mean over its trading days and the three seeds is > 0
thresholds.note_zh: 0.003 沿用已注册对照口径（约 132 日 9 种子标准差 0.00247 的 1.2 倍）；要求 CI 不含零且 7/10 窗为正，是为了同时约束幅度与跨窗一致性

primary.seed_pooling: mean of the three paired seeds before the pooled window mean
primary.statistic: pooled paired RankIC difference over the 203 trading days

secondary.rank_ic_by_window: per-window pooled paired difference, reported even when the primary fails
secondary.positive_windows: count of windows with a positive window mean, must be >= 7 of 10
secondary.diagnostics: per-horizon RankIC of each head on the official 30-minute label, the blend's cross-horizon rank agreement, turnover and long/short spread under the eval-v2 contract; all reported, none may replace the primary

decision_rule_zh: 池化配对差 >= 0.003 且 20000 draws 的 95% CI 下界 > 0 且至少 7/10 窗为正，才判本臂通过；任一条不满足即判不通过并保留单头对照；通过后仍需在其它种子或时段复验才能替换主模型

ordering.note_zh: 本文件写于任何多头候选训练之前，写入时不存在任何候选分数；注册是之后的独立动作

cost_cap.note_zh: 三进程并行，单进程 wall 上限沿用 441 日 rung 的 9000 秒

homogeneity.host: hz-3 / hz-4 matpool hosts, torch from /root/py312
homogeneity.note_zh: 候选与对照必须使用同一台机器、同一 torch 版本、同线程数，且同时段内不与他人争 GPU

label_audit.note: the 60-minute lane is NaN on the 14:30 clock (12.68% of rows), which is the intended edge case, not a row drop; the 30-minute column of the attached matrix is the official target verbatim

multi_head_smoke.measured_on: hz-t3 ZW75JY, /root/py312, CPU device, seed 11, 30 steps, 2026-10-28

evidence.estimator_note_zh: 本臂的区块 bootstrap 必须调用仓库内修复版 compare_blend_replay.block_interval（sha 0bf08a47…），不得另写实现

risks_zh: 对照臂（441 日 @1.32、三种子、十窗）的十窗回放必须先按同一 harness 产出，否则配对差不成立
hz-t3 上的 scripts/compare_blend_replay.py 仍是 2026-10-28 之前的单块版本；分析机必须使用修好的 block_interval，退役估计量不得用于判定
5/15/60 头用的是由 1 分钟 bar 重建的标签；在 30 分钟主期限上与官方列的相关 0.9937、中位绝对差 5.9e-7、53.1% 落在 1e-6 内、最大 1.06e-2（bar 区间被截断的边缘行）
60 分钟头在 14:30 时钟上必然缺失（约 12.68% 行），损失按期限掩码跳过，不能因此丢行
混合权重是固定 1/K、优化单位等权；若训练后发现各头量纲差异很大，本文件不允许事后改权重
候选配方沿用对照的 experiment_id / output_root；runner 每次分配唯一时间戳目录不会覆盖，但建议启动时显式覆盖到独立 output_root 以免两臂混在同一目录
scope_limits_zh: 不调超参、不改学习率/批大小/epochs
不改门槛、不改权重、不改窗口集合
本臂只回答标签期限这一个因素，不与其他因素同时变化

uncertainty.semantics: ceil(n/5) contiguous 5-day blocks per replicate with random start points and wraparound, then the mean over the spliced n days; the replicate distribution is the sampling distribution of the pooled n-day mean
uncertainty.retired_estimator: archived_single_block_interval (one 5-day block mean per replicate) is retained for provenance only and may never gate a decision
uncertainty.debt_note_zh: 旧口径把半宽放大 sqrt(n/5)（n=203 约 6.4 倍），2026-10-28 已修；本臂的主判定只用修复版实现

windows.read_discipline: the eight screen windows may be read repeatedly; jun2024 and sep2024 are the frozen confirmation windows and may be read only once, and only on the captain's release

fusion.score_units: the multi-horizon score is the fixed equal average of the four heads in their own optimization units; it is not a 30-minute return quantity
fusion.rule: before any blend or comparison against the single-head candidate, each arm's scores are cross-sectionally rank-normalized within every timestamp; raw-score averaging across arms is forbidden
fusion.rationale_zh: 各头与单头在各自的标准化单位上，直接平均会让尺度支配融合结果；秩变换在每个时间戳内做，与比赛的同刻跨股票排序口径一致
fusion.downstream_warning: the score must not be treated as an expected return for thresholding or position sizing

registration.decided_scope: three seeds x scored point mh-1.32 on the 441-day rung, four horizons 5/15/30/60; the mh-stepup-1.33 point exists only to satisfy the trajectory driver and is never compared

estimator.note: the repaired block_interval; the retired single-block estimator may not gate

registration.window_policy: screening reads the eight screening windows only (165 trading days = 33 blocks); jun2024 and sep2024 are released for reading by the captain alone, and a direction released once may not be re-read
registration.threshold_status: unchanged from the draft floor: min_improvement 0.003, CI excluding zero, at least seven of ten windows positive
registration.smoke_status: plan-level static gate passed on hz-t3 (trajectory_config accepted all three plans, deviations only model.max_steps and output_root, derived steps 145269/146370 at usable 3521680); arm-level evidence (default path bit-identical, 15 unit tests, four non-zero head gradients, roundtrip 0.0, +1.0 MB RSS) sits in the draft evidence block

identity_repair.why_zh: 生成器把 441 日阶梯的 experiment_id/output_root 原样带进了候选配方（scaling-441d-seedN），会让这臂被误认成已注册阶梯并写进同一个目录

provenance_open_items: hz-t3 derives 145269 steps and hz-4 145290 for the same 1.32 point; the arm runs on hz-t3 and the number is re-derived at run start and recorded in budget.json
registration.host_note: the plans' cloud.host text still names hz-4 (template inheritance); the arm actually runs on hz-t3 in /root/repo_mh, the same cosmetic deviation as the 600-day extension

known_limitations_zh: 30 分钟头用官方标签原值，5/15/60 分钟头由 1 分钟 bar 重算，两者仍有约 0.4% 的 tick vs bar 边界差（corr 0.9916、中位差 1.1e-7）
多头分数是各头优化单位的等权平均，不是收益量纲；跨臂融合必须先做每个 timestamp 的横截面秩归一化
未跑过真实 12 epoch/145290 步，只有 3 天窗口端到端与 3-30 步冒烟
next_steps_after_user_review: 起跑三条 seed × mh-1.32（hz-t3，排在 R2 与标签波动率调整之后）
十窗回放后用修复版 block_interval 做配对判定
